proposal_metadata.plan_registration: Create a dedicated plan-only branch from fixed base 7b2485f50064379019f89a7b29c4de73b8533556; add only the plan JSON at docs/approval_plans/CB6_F01_SUCCESSOR_APPROVAL_PLAN_20261020.json and commit it. Keep cb6-v2-clean untouched. Record the immutable plan commit SHA and path for the later owner approval and successor PR metadata. Separate owner authorization required before any GitHub write.
proposal_metadata.canonical_sha256_rule: Take only proposed_change_id,basis_head,planned_paths,forbidden_scope,affected_domains; sort the three array values; serialize with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(comma,colon)); SHA256 UTF-8 bytes. This draft does not compute a digest.
preconditions: The plan is fixed in GitHub before the owner comment.
Owner comment must predate successor PR creation.
Plan basis_head must equal successor PR base SHA.
Successor PR changed-file set must equal planned_paths.
Preexisting edits are not retroactively certified as pre-implementation approved.
Independent review PASS is inherited only for identical document content; new differences require separate assessment.
unknowns: Plan commit SHA and plan path are not established.
Owner GitHub approval comment ID and timestamp do not exist for this proposal.
Successor PR branch/head and Required Check result not established.
Proposed plan-only and successor branch names are not created; availability and permissions are unverified.
The plan commit and successor PR must remain separately authorized and unexecuted until owner approval.

plan_registration_route.base_mutation: FORBIDDEN: do not merge plan-only branch into cb6-v2-clean or main
approval_order: fix plan JSON in separate commit
record plan commit SHA and canonical plan digest without retroactive claims
owner posts exact two-line approval comment on repository Issue
create successor PR after owner comment

successor_pr_route.transfer_method: Copy the exact source file content from the fixed source commit into a new branch based on the fixed base, then commit only that document path. Do not cherry-pick a commit that changes other paths. Do not include plan JSON in successor PR diff.
successor_pr_route.scope_requirement: PR changed-file path set must equal the single planned_paths entry; document bytes must match fixed source to inherit F01-R8 PASS
successor_pr_route.approval_requirement: Create successor PR only after GitHub owner approval comment, and include all seven required PR body fields
stop_conditions: approval comment is not earlier than PR creation
plan commit or plan SHA mismatch
